meta.title: Mobilcab roadmap — what we ship, and in what order
meta.description: Mobilcab ships in stages: 3D design and cut lists first, then nesting, CNC, team, subscriptions and AI. No fake dates — just order and status.

hero.label: Product roadmap
hero.title: We ship in stages — each one useful on its own.
hero.body: We don't promise “full CAD and CNC tomorrow.” We build in order: workshop basics first (design + cut lists), then the next stage only when the current one is stable on real projects.

stages.title: 3D design + cut list
stages.body: Design furniture in 3D, save to the cloud, and get the parts list — what you cut in the workshop. That's the foundation: without a cut list, the project isn't worth investing in.

stages.title: Sheet nesting + labels + quotes
stages.body: Lay parts on sheets, print labels, and work out costs so you can give the client a clear quote.

stages.title: CNC export
stages.body: Machine files once nesting is solid. A repeatable flow you can rely on — not “every CNC in the world” on day one.

stages.title: Team and sharing
stages.body: Workshop work with roles, invites, and a view-only link for the client — without opening the whole shop to them.

stages.title: Subscriptions
stages.body: Paid plans when the value (export, workshop tools) is clear. Until then, generous access to design and cut lists.

stages.title: AI + renders
stages.body: A layout assistant and visuals for presentations. Premium extras — they don't block the core workshop stages.

a: So you get something useful in the workshop sooner — not a half-finished tool on every front. Each stage has to stand on its own before we open the next one.
After design, cut lists and nesting are stable on real projects. CNC export without reliable nesting only frustrates you at the machine — that's why it's stage three, not stage one.

items.q: Can I use design only for now?
a: Yes. Stage 1 (3D design + cut list) is the foundation we launch first. You can work with it without waiting for nesting, CNC or AI.

cta.title: Try the foundation now
cta.body: Design and cut lists — the next step when you're ready.
